hints.title: Bidirectional Traffic Aggregation
hints.text: Every scheduled flight adds to both the departure and arrival airport traffic counts.

hints.title: Union of Flight Legs
hints.text: Use union all to normalize departure and arrival columns into a single airport_id and traffic stream.

hints.title: Dense Rank Filtering
hints.text: Group by airport_id, compute total traffic, and filter for records matching the maximum traffic rank.

hints.title: Complete Implementation
hints.text:
```sql
WITH Traffic AS (
    SELECT departure_airport AS airport_id, flights_count FROM Flights
    UNION ALL
    SELECT arrival_airport AS airport_id, flights_count FROM Flights
),
Agg AS (
    SELECT airport_id, SUM(flights_count) AS total_traffic,
           DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(flights_count) DESC) AS rnk
    FROM Traffic
    GROUP BY airport_id
)
SELECT airport_id
FROM Agg
WHERE rnk = 1;
```

complexity.time: O(N log N) aggregation and ranking across airport appearances
variables: N: number of flight records in Flights table
complexity.notes: Flights contribute traffic to both departure and arrival airports.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Evaluating departure and arrival airports separately without combining traffic undercounts dual-role hubs.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Union all merges bidirectional flight legs into a single airport aggregation stream.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should combine departure and arrival traffic before finding the maximum traffic.

solutions.code:
import pandas as pd

def airport_with_most_traffic(flights: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    dep = flights[['departure_airport', 'flights_count']].rename(columns={'departure_airport': 'airport_id'})
    arr = flights[['arrival_airport', 'flights_count']].rename(columns={'arrival_airport': 'airport_id'})
    comb = pd.concat([dep, arr], ignore_index=True)
    grouped = comb.groupby('airport_id', as_index=False)['flights_count'].sum()
    max_traffic = grouped['flights_count'].max()
    res = grouped[grouped['flights_count'] == max_traffic][['airport_id']]
    return res
